# Tuesday, March 17, 2026

## The reminder outage

Most of the day went to our worst incident so far: reminders for 61 clinics delayed or never sent between mid-morning and early evening. A tenant migration batch used up the database connections, and the reminder retries that followed ran into Pingrove's rate limit. The timeline, impact and causes are in the [[reminder-outage-2026-03-17|incident note]]; the concept behind the first failure is in [[connection-exhaustion|connection exhaustion]].

## Who did what

Kwabena took incident command within minutes of the page and ran it well. Pablo carried every clinic call and the 30-minute updates. Hamish found that the workers ignored the retry header, which turned the afternoon around. I took the scribe role while also answering Renata and Meridale, and the notes have gaps because of it. I should not have done both.

## Decided today

The [[full-tenant-database-rollout|tenant rollout]] is paused until we understand the connection problem. The blameless review is set for next Tuesday, with Kwabena facilitating. Clinics that lost reminders will get a list from us rather than having to ask.
